does: Evaluates one compiled stats condition by its index in the condition manager (index -1 is true) against a condition context, through the Lua condition runtime; the result is the verdict and the rolls the condition made. The common frame of every roll asked by a stats condition: a spell's SpellRoll, a status's RemoveConditions or OnApplyRoll.

evidence.says: index -1 returns success at once; otherwise looks the index up in the manager (+0x30, +0x98) and runs it through 0xF00130 -> 0xF00720 -> 0xF068F0 into the Lua runtime
the caller chains of Sacred Flame's save, a goblin's weapon attack, HOLD_PERSON's repeat save and See Invisibility's save all pass it at +0xEFFBA1
